notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least 3.
description:
Cast Nyx Lotus by paying its mana cost.
When Nyx Lotus enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Nyx Lotus that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Nyx Lotus into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
During your next turn, activate the Nyx Lotus token by tapping it, adding an amount of mana equal to your devotion to any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Nyx Lotus token.
Repeat from step 4.
